profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, trading under the ticker AI. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001577526, and it is also known as C3.AI INC-A. The website associated with the company, airliquide.com, describes Air Liquide as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. According to that site, Air Liquide serves 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees.

The website also announces the creation of a research chair titled "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry" by Air Liquide, the École normale supérieure and its Foundation. The available data lists a California law exposure count of 281 for C3.ai, Inc. No products, litigation cases, or MCP servers are associated with the company in the available data.
